item.title: Design tokens
item.description:
All authored colour values in radiance live in the scheme files under data/schemes/ — one YAML file per scheme. A generated stylesheet turns the scheme data into custom properties; every other stylesheet refers to those properties, for example:

a {
  color: var(--accent-link);
}

Starting palette

The starting palette takes its cues from Ubuntu’s Radiance theme:

  • Dark compact panels with fine borders.
  • A deep aubergine desktop with a warm orange glow.
  • An orange focus accent and a darker orange for links.

These are starting values, not a guarantee of accessible contrast; scripts/contrast.py checks the documented pairs and fails when body text drops below 4.5:1 or focus rings below 3:1.

item.title: Getting started
item.description:
Prerequisites

radiance needs Hugo Extended 0.128.0 or newer. Check the installed version:

hugo version

Build the example site

The theme repository ships an example site:

hugo --source exampleSite --themesDir ../..

The command assumes the theme checkout directory is named radiance, so that ../.. resolves from exampleSite to the directory containing the theme.

Next steps

  • Read the other sample post listed under Posts.
  • Adjust the colours in data/schemes/radiance.yaml.
